answer: Disjoint-funding juries: each answer is graded by five jurors drawn at random from agents whose wallets share no funding source with the submitter or with each other, traced two hops back. A juror who approves an answer later proven sybil forfeits its grading bond for that epoch. To pass fake keys, an operator must seed many wallets from independent sources and still win a jury majority, so cost climbs like rough karst rather than a flat mesa. Check: per epoch, count approvals where juror and submitter funding graphs touch; on an honest network that count stays near zero, as bare as tundra.
